deadline.value: Apply by February 1 for Fall admission (October 1 for Spring); late applications are considered case by case.
deadline.quote: Deadlines are February 1 for Fall admission and October 1 for Spring admission (although late applications are accepted on a case-by-case basis).

gre_general.quote: GRE – The GRE is not required.

supervisor.value: Individual faculty alone decide on admission, and no student is admitted without a designated faculty major advisor, so contact faculty first.
supervisor.quote: No student is admitted without a designated faculty major advisor.

funding.value: Funding is not promised: students are often supported by advisors' research assistantships, and others by teaching assistantships.
funding.quote: Often, students can be supported by their advisors through extramural funding for student research assistantships, and others gain financial support and teaching experience through teaching assistantships.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

entry_route.value: Not stated on the pages checked

notes: Concentrations include wildlife and fish conservation, forest resources, water and watersheds, environmental policy and sustainable building.
